features.name: Hungry Eyes
features.description: At 1st level, you can sense when non-undead, non-construct creatures within 30 ft are below half their HP maximum. Your spell attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover when targeting such creatures.

features.name: Thirsty Soul
features.description: Beginning at 1st level, when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 HP, regain HP equal to your sorcerer level + CHA modifier (min 1). Can't restore more than half your HP maximum this way.

features.name: Feast of Arcana
features.description: Starting at 6th level, when you reduce one or more hostile creatures to 0 HP with a 1st level+ spell, regain 1 spent sorcery point.

features.name: Glutton for Punishment
features.description: Starting at 14th level, use your reaction to intentionally fail a saving throw against a damaging spell cast by a hostile creature. If you do, regain spent sorcery points equal to half your CHA modifier (min 1).

payload.name: Glutton for Punishment
payload.description: Intentionally fail a save against a hostile creature's damaging spell: regain sorcery points equal to half CHA mod (min 1).

features.name: Greedy Heart
features.description: At 18th level, when you spend sorcery points to create spell slots or use Metamagic, reduce the cost by 1 sorcery point (minimum 1).
